title: Foundry day job and the end of his first marriage
summary: Monk kept the foundry job; his marriage ended because of his getting into the music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Were you still working your day job too?

Yeah, I continued working in the foundry, because I was having very, very serious -- once I started playing -- I had very very serious domestic problems, at home. In fact, my marriage ended because of my getting into the music. I can understand it very clearly now. I couldn't then. I wasn't able to; I guess I just wasn't adult enough to understand. And the same thing with my first wife, neither was she. But you know, that's how a lot of mistakes are made. It's because we haven't grown up, no matter what the age, has nothing to do with it. But at the age of 28, I still hadn't grown up.
